This is my favorite chocolate chip cookie recipe.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups flour
  • 1 cup sugar
  • 1 cup butter
  • 2 cups chocolate chips

Prep time: 15 minutes. Cook time: 12 minutes. Servings: 24 cookies.

Instructions

  1. Cream butter and sugar.
  2. Add flour gradually.
  3. Fold in chocolate chips.
  4. Bake at 180°C for 12 minutes.
